newsitem.title: CANADA: Moore says 12.9 mln shrs tendered for offer.
newsitem.headline: Moore says 12.9 mln shrs tendered for offer.

text.p: Moore Corp said on Thursday a preliminary report from R-M Trust Company indicated that 12.9 million shares were tendered to Moore's share purchase offer.
Moore said its buyback offer for 12 million shares at C$30.90 each closed on April 29.
Moore said that based on the number of shares tendered, the accepted shares would be subject to a proration factor of about 93 percent, subject to verification.
The business forms giant said it anticipated that payment for the shares would be made by May 30.
It said the purchase represented about a 12 percent buyback of the total shares outstanding and would leave Moore with 88 million common shares outstanding when the transactions were completed.
